question: Where can I get a list of thermal and nuclear power plants in Germany, with location, fuel or technology, capacity (MW), operator, status and annual generation?

answer.summary: Germany’s Bundesnetzagentur publishes the Kraftwerksliste for units at sites of at least 10 MW, with fuel, gross and net capacity, operator and status. SMARD provides site coordinates and publishes annual net generation for units of at least 100 MW. MaStR is the underlying unit register. No nuclear unit remains in operation.
main_caveats: Do not count reserves as operation: 1,488 thermal units (incl. biomass) 'InBetrieb', 57,399 MW net, vs about 14.7 GW in grid/capacity reserve, KVBG phase-out or temporary closure; MaStR shows such units as 'In Betrieb'.

Kraftwerksliste reports the Bundesland without coordinates. In the MaStR export tested, coordinates, municipality and postcode were absent for sampled units of at least 10 MW. SMARD provides one point per site.
SMARD reports annual MWh from 100 MW. ENTSO-E reports average MW per interval and requires a token. This review found no per-unit generation figures for smaller CHP and industrial units.
Bases differ: Kraftwerksliste gross and net MW, MaStR kW, UBA gross MW, ENTSO-E net MW; LEAG plant totals run 3.5-4.6% above ENTSO-E-based sums without stating gross or net.
All 9 nuclear rows in the Kraftwerksliste are 'endgültig stillgelegt' (2015-2023); historical nuclear generation per unit is in Energy-Charts nuclear_unit files.
answer.confidence_reason: Kraftwerksliste, SMARD metadata, MaStR export and JSON, UBA list and Energy-Charts files were downloaded and counted; SMARD unit series match Energy-Charts within 0.5%; the ENTSO-E API (token) was not queried.

attributes.note: SMARD gives one coordinate pair per site. The availability of coordinates, postcode and municipality in MaStR varies by unit.
Per unit: Energietraeger, Hauptbrennstoff, Technologie (Kraftwerksliste); further fuels in MaStR (WeitereBrennstoffe); fuel mixes as text in UBA.
Kraftwerksliste: Bruttoleistung_MW and Nettonennleistung_MW per unit; MaStR the same in kW; SMARD net MW; UBA gross only.
Anlagenbetreiber per unit (blank only for permanently closed units); MaStR operator id ABR... and name; SMARD company per site.
Kraftwerksstatus separates InBetrieb, grid/capacity reserve, KVBG phase-out, temporary and permanent closure; MaStR has only 4 states.
SMARD reports annual MWh for units from 100 MW. Some operators publish plant totals. Generation per unit below that threshold was not found in the sources checked.
attributes.gap_note: No per-unit annual generation found for units < 100 MW: MaStR has no generation field, Destatis publishes only totals by energy source, SMARD/ENTSO-E stop at 100 MW.

sources.name: SMARD Kraftwerksdaten: power plant master data and per-unit generation series
sources.format: JSON (metadata and chart_data series); CSV/XLSX/XML via the download centre
sources.summary: BNetzA's SMARD gives every listed site (>= 10 MW) with coordinates, address, operator, block status and net MW, and official annual net generation (MWh) per unit >= 100 MW.
sources.coverage_note: 596 sites / 1,956 blocks (583 sites in Germany); generation series for 212 blocks.
caveats: Coordinates per site, not per block.

example.example_request: curl -s 'https://www.smard.de/app/chart_data/970/Amprion/970_Amprion_year_1735686000000.json'  # productionId 970 = Niederaußem K, region = plant regionId from https://www.smard.de/app/power_plant_data/power_plant_metadata.json

sources.name: Kraftwerksliste der Bundesnetzagentur (Gesamtkraftwerksliste)
sources.format: XLSX (also CSV: semicolon-separated, Windows-1252, decimal comma)
sources.summary: Official unit list (sites >= 10 MW net) with fuel, gross/net MW, operator and detailed status including reserves and closures; location only by Bundesland.
sources.coverage_note: Germany plus foreign plants feeding the German grid; 1,965 named thermal/nuclear units, 1,488 in operation (57,399 MW net).
caveats: Status 'InBetrieb' excludes reserves, which have their own states.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o Kraftwerksliste.xlsx 'https://www.bundesnetzagentur.de/DE/Fachthemen/ElektrizitaetundGas/Versorgungssicherheit/Erzeugungskapazitaeten/Kraftwerksliste/_DL/Kraftwerksliste.xlsx?__blob=publicationFile&v=18'  # sheet 'Gesamtkraftwerksliste', header in row 6, data from row 7

sources.name: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR): Gesamtdatenexport and public unit overview
sources.format: ZIP of XML files (UTF-16); JSON from the public unit overview
sources.summary: The national registry: all units with dates, gross/net kW, fuels, operator and four-state status; large units' location is reduced to PLZ/place (web) or Landkreis (export).
sources.coverage_note: 94,203 combustion units and 6 nuclear units in the 2026-10-01 export; coordinates only for units of about 30 kW to < 10 MW.

problems: Full export exceeds 100 MB: tested by headers, a Range read of the ZIP directory (440 files) and Range extraction of EinheitenVerbrennung.xml (94,203 units), EinheitenKernkraft.xml (6 units) and Katalogwerte.xml; overview JSON queried directly (api_query).

sources.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform: Actual Generation per Generation Unit (Article 16.1.a)
sources.summary: Official per-unit actual net generation (MW per interval) for units >= 100 MW; annual totals require summing a year of data and a free API token.

problems: API requires a personal security token (HTTP 401 'Authentication failed.' without it).
Web view is a JavaScript application with no server-rendered content.
Help article on tokens (transparencyplatform.zendesk.com) rejects automated clients (403 JavaScript challenge).

sources.name: Energy-Charts: annual electricity generation per power plant unit
sources.summary: Non-official annual generation per unit (TWh) for German units >= 100 MW, derived from ENTSO-E/EEX, joinable by EIC.
sources.coverage_note: 2025: 110 lignite, hard coal, gas, oil and waste units; nuclear_unit series tested for 2022 (3 units, 32.69 TWh).

if_unstructured.summary: Per-unit annual generation below 100 MW is not published as data; operators sometimes publish plant totals in web pages or EMAS statements, with differing bases.

local_terms.meaning: BNetzA power plant list (units at sites >= 10 MW) with status.
National register of generating units; Gesamtdatenexport and public unit overview.
Lifecycle column of the Kraftwerksliste (InBetrieb, Netzreserve, endgültig stillgelegt ...).
Generating unit; MaStR numbers start with SEE.
Main fuel of a combustion unit (e.g. Rohbraunkohlen, Erdgas).
Reserve states; units may not sell on the market.
